text: Imisoro AI is a Rwandan product that helps VAT-registered businesses and accountants prepare for VAT filing in the official RRA eTax portal.
Imisoro is built specifically for Rwanda's VAT-registered businesses and for the RRA's EBM (Electronic Billing Machine) and e-Tax environment.
Founder and Product Lead of Imisoro AI: Emily Kirabo, based in Kigali, Rwanda.
Official Imisoro website: https://imisoroai.nutekh.com/
Supported languages in Imisoro: English (the product default), Kinyarwanda, and Français. Guidance and the user interface are available in all three.

Positioning: Imisoro is a review workspace, not a black box. It helps organize the work — capture, verify, explain, and hand off — but does NOT replace a professional accountant and does NOT submit government filings.

Imisoro does NOT file returns for the user. It prepares evidence and summaries; the user or their accountant makes the filing decisions, and the return itself is completed and submitted in the official RRA eTax portal.
Human review stays in control: Imisoro's AI extracts fields and highlights uncertainty, and the user approves every classification.
Original invoices are retained in Imisoro. Source documents stay attached to the extracted records so they remain reviewable and exportable.
Imisoro keeps an audit trail. Every result stays reviewable, exportable, and connected to its original source.
Trust basics of Imisoro: Original files retained · Human approval · Audit trail.
Imisoro AI enhances and speeds up human judgment — it does not replace professional accountants or official government portals.
Imisoro three-step workflow — Step 1 (Capture): upload every document (PDF, photo, or EBM receipt) before it disappears into a WhatsApp thread or a drawer.
Imisoro three-step workflow — Step 2 (Review): the AI extracts the fields, highlights uncertainty, and keeps the source document attached. The user approves each classification.
Imisoro three-step workflow — Step 3 (Prepare for eTax): build a period-based review pack, then complete and submit the return in the official RRA eTax portal.
For business owners: Imisoro lets you know which invoices need attention before they become a filing problem.
For accountants: Imisoro delivers structured, reviewable evidence instead of a folder of unclear photos sent by the client.
For real-world work: Imisoro keeps the human decision in the loop and explains every classification.
The monthly close with Imisoro revolves around four moves: capture, verify, explain, and hand off — so the business and its accountant work from the same source of truth.
Imisoro helps organize EBM evidence, review purchase VAT, reconcile sales records, and build a period-based filing pack.
The focus of the current Imisoro version is monthly unsupported-expense schedule assembly for registered, VAT-paying Kigali SMEs using the RRA EBM and e-Tax systems.
Imisoro's classification engine tags expenses as supported vs unsupported following RRA rules. Each classification is reviewable and must be approved by the user before it enters the filing pack.
Target sectors for Imisoro: high-volume transaction sectors — retail, trade, professional services, and hospitality.
Primary users of Imisoro: SME business owners, in-house accountants, and tax operators.
MVP validation result: with active Kigali SMEs, tax preparation time was reduced by more than 75% — bringing tax-prep tasks from several hours to under 60 minutes.
Qualitative MVP feedback: large increase in categorization confidence; multilingual explanations (Kinyarwanda, English, French) were praised as a stand-out differentiator.

Structured pilot plan: 4-month cohort with 20-30 VAT-registered Kigali SMEs across retail, hospitality, and professional services. Month 1 = onboarding and staff training. Months 2-3 = active monthly filing use, supported by a dedicated WhatsApp and phone helpline. Month 4 = evaluation and preparation for broader rollout.

Six key metrics measured in the Imisoro pilot: Time Efficiency (hours saved per declaration), Classification Accuracy (AI vs RRA rules), Explanation Clarity (user comprehension across languages), System Reliability (edge cases), User Confidence (trust in classifications), and Adoption & Retention (long-term monthly usage).
FAQ — Does Imisoro file returns for me? No. Imisoro prepares the evidence and summaries; the user or their accountant makes the filing decisions in the RRA eTax portal.
FAQ — Can I keep the original invoice? Yes. Source documents stay attached to the extracted records for review and export.
FAQ — Who is Imisoro for? Rwanda SMEs, finance teams, and accounting firms.
Imisoro brand promise: Make every invoice count.
Imisoro brand promise: From scattered receipts to a clear evidence trail.
Imisoro brand promise: Less chasing. More confidence at month-end.
To get started with Imisoro, a user creates a workspace from the website, uploads their first invoice, and reviews what needs their attention. The CTA on the site is 'Create workspace'.
